'''Cassandra Hawthorne''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Cassandra was one of the many scientists assigned to work in Vault 4 to research the effects of [[radiation]] on [[human]] DNA.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Trap]]===
Cassandra, her husband [[Lloyd Hawthorne]], and two unnamed children appear in a commercial advertisement for [[Vault 4]]. They appear eating dinner at their table, where [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]] joins them. He tells the viewers that she and her husband are both scientists who will be studying the effects of Radiation on Human DNA. Cassandra confirms it and notes that they'll be living in Vault 4, leading a community led by scientists.
